uncertainty: Source precision retained. No confidence interval is invented. 2026 harmonized microdata analysis covers 84 countries; it does not establish effects on wages, hiring or layoffs. Do not compare with 2025 employment-denominator estimates as a trend.
limitations: 2026 harmonized microdata analysis covers 84 countries; it does not establish effects on wages, hiring or layoffs.
Do not compare with 2025 employment-denominator estimates as a trend.
Brief count text has an internal occupation-count inconsistency; no occupation counts derived. Female/male dominance is an operational sample classification, not biological attribution.
2026 is the analysis publication year, not a common fieldwork year for84countries. No temporal change estimate is supported.
